_comment: Control for the 1/4 input scaling (report item 2). mooncake_w1_out4 = the same W1 tasks, prompts and arrivals as mooncake_baseline, with every output length also divided by 4. Run 1 is an overload calibration (550 tasks, as mooncake_calib) giving this variant's X'; runs 2-3 replay the exact 0.95X task set of w1_fifo_c4_l95(_cram8g) for a matched-task comparison. Compare with python -m analysis.reprefill. If X' is much larger than 0.330, the matched set is lightly loaded; add a run at 0.95X' afterwards. 6144 tokens per slot. Run 4 (added after the first pass showed the 282-task set is lightly loaded for this variant) repeats the 550-task set with the 8 GiB host cache.
name: mooncake_out4
